einzeiler: College football breakdowns, Booger McFarland, and life advice on roommates and dating.
kurzfassung: Booger McFarland joins the show to analyze early college football storylines, including Texas, Ohio State, and the upcoming LSU-Ole Miss matchup. Oklahoma State quarterback Drew Mestemaker shares his unlikely journey to college football success. Finally, the hosts tackle listener emails offering life advice on wedding anniversary etiquette, grocery store ethics, and housing dilemmas.
stichpunkte: Booger McFarland evaluates early college football impressions, focusing on Texas, Ohio State, and Oregon.
Discussion centers on LSU and Ole Miss heading into their highly anticipated matchup.
Oklahoma State quarterback Drew Mestemaker talks about his path from a zero-star walk-on to starring in a big win against Oregon.
Analysis of NFL teams, specifically examining the early season challenges for the Rams.
Life advice segment addresses whether it is weird to text a friend happy anniversary for their wedding.
The hosts debate the ethics of snacking on poke items while grocery shopping in upscale stores.
A listener asks for advice on whether to move out from a house shared with four roommates at age 29.
Reflection on goal setting, personal fulfillment, and shifting motivations through different life stages.

beschreibung:
Ryen is joined by ESPN’s Booger McFarland, looking back on how massive the Texas comeback win over Ohio State was for coach Sark, who the class of the Big Ten is, Lane Kiffin going back to Ole Miss, and whether the Rams are actually going to keep struggling. Then, Oklahoma State quarterback Drew Mestemaker stops by to talk about the upset win over Oregon and how he went from a zero-star recruit to a potential first-round pick in the NFL Draft. And finally, Kyle and Ceruti hop in for some listener-submitted Life Advice, including a friend who is too nice and the challenges of moving out with your buddies.
